summary: I built the record in EspoCRM's Create Opportunity form but ran out of turns before clicking Save, so the opportunity was NOT persisted and could not be verified as existing. What I did confirm on the live page: the Name field held "fwec24-fc-n1 Bench Opportunity"; the Account field was committed not by typing but by choosing the suggestion — after typing "Bench" the autocomplete option list appeared and clicking the "Bench Account" option closed the list and rendered the value as "Bench Account" (a real selected record, chip present); the Description field held "fwec24-fc-n1"; Amount committed as "1,000.00" after leaving the field; and Close Date was picked through the datepicker to 2026-12-31 (the field read "2026-12-31"). Note the date field's free-typing path is unreliable — typing "12/31/2026" and tabbing out produced a wrong parsed value "2018-01-16", which is why I set it via the calendar widget instead. Since Save was never pressed, nothing was written to the database and there is no opportunity record id to report; a subsequent run should create the record from scratch (there should be no duplicate left behind, but I could not verify the list after abandoning the form).
